description: Deterministic policy mappings from measured transcript-quality conditions to severity, rationale and bounded remediation guidance.

policies.rationale_template: Column {column_name} has a fill rate of {metric_value_pct}, below the expected threshold of {threshold_pct}.

recommended_actions.title: Trace missing-value origin
recommended_actions.description_template: Review upstream extraction and mapping for {column_name}; compare missingness by ingestion batch and source.

recommended_actions.title: Confirm null policy
recommended_actions.description_template: Confirm whether {column_name} is mandatory for its business domain and document approved exceptions.

policies.rationale_template: The dominant topic represents {metric_value_pct} of classified interactions, which may indicate classification collapse, selection bias or a genuine operational concentration.

recommended_actions.title: Validate topic classification
recommended_actions.description_template: Compare the dominant topic across source, month and interaction direction before treating the concentration as a data defect.

recommended_actions.title: Review topic taxonomy
recommended_actions.description_template: Check whether topic aliases or fallback categories are absorbing otherwise distinct intents.

policies.rationale_template: Invalid, missing or inconsistent speaker tags were observed at a rate of {metric_value_pct} in {column_name}.

recommended_actions.title: Compare corrected transcript
recommended_actions.description_template: Compare speaker structure between raw and corrected-tag transcript variants and isolate affected pipeline versions.

recommended_actions.title: Validate agent mapping
recommended_actions.description_template: Check speaker labels against available agent identifiers and interaction direction metadata.

policies.rationale_template: Non-English or unrecognized tokens represent {metric_value_pct} of evaluated tokens in {column_name}. This is an indicator, not proof of misspelling.

recommended_actions.title: Segment by detected language
recommended_actions.description_template: Separate genuine multilingual conversations from transcription errors before remediation.

recommended_actions.title: Review redacted token sample
recommended_actions.description_template: Review only bounded and redacted unknown-token evidence for product names, acronyms and systematic ASR errors.

policies.rationale_template: Suspected mistranslated or ASR-substituted tokens represent {metric_value_pct} of evaluated tokens in {column_name}.

recommended_actions.title: Compare transcript variants
recommended_actions.description_template: Compare raw, clean and corrected transcripts using bounded aggregate error counts to locate the transformation stage introducing the issue.

recommended_actions.title: Review confusion lexicon
recommended_actions.description_template: Validate recurring substitutions with domain SMEs before updating the approved mistranslation lexicon.

policies.rationale_template: Potential PII patterns were detected in {metric_value_pct} of evaluated records for {column_name}. Evidence must contain only type and count, never matched values.

recommended_actions.title: Restrict and remediate exposure
recommended_actions.description_template: Apply access controls and investigate the redaction stage using PII type counts and source lineage only.

recommended_actions.title: Validate detection precision
recommended_actions.description_template: Review false-positive rates using authorized masked evidence before changing detection patterns.

policies.rationale_template: The aggregate speech rate of {metric_value} words per minute is outside the expected range [{lower_threshold}, {upper_threshold}].

recommended_actions.title: Validate duration units
recommended_actions.description_template: Confirm that media duration is populated in milliseconds and is aligned to the same interaction as the transcript.

recommended_actions.title: Check transcript completeness
recommended_actions.description_template: Compare transcript length, speech duration and non-speech duration aggregates for evidence of truncation or duplication.
